# A dropped connection says so {antenna.radiowaves.left.and.right}
A phone that lost its connection to this Mac sat on "Reconnecting" for as
long as you looked at it. It now says the connection dropped, and one tap
starts again.

---

Everything else in this release:

- A live session that has dropped no longer holds the place, so another
  phone is not told somebody else is watching when nobody is.
